description:
Found by the #423 probes (s424), PRE-EXISTING.

    sub foo { 42 }
    our $gb = \*main::foo;      # a PACKAGE variable
    *main::b2 = $gb;
    print main::b2();

    perl : 42
    PCL  : "The function main::pl-b2 is undefined."  (crash)

With `my $gb = \*main::foo` the same three lines work.

CAUSE -- two representations of a glob REFERENCE in a box:
  (rep 1) box(value = p-typeglob, is-ref = t)      -- what box-set stores, i.e.
          every LEXICAL assignment;
  (rep 2) box(value = box(value = p-typeglob, is-ref = t)) -- what
          `p-scalar-=`'s literal-`(p-backslash ...)` branch stores, i.e. a
          PACKAGE variable assigned a `\*foo` literal.
`%p-glob-assign-slots` does `(let ((inner (if (p-box-p rhs) (unbox rhs) rhs))))`
and dispatches on `inner`: for rep 2 `inner` is the inner BOX, so the
`(p-typeglob-p inner)` arm misses and the `((p-box-p inner) ...)` arm fires --
installing the SCALAR slot (`$main::b2`) instead of copying the glob.

s424 fixed the STRINGIFICATION half of rep 2 (`%p-ref-string` had no typeglob
referent arm, so `our $r = \*STDOUT; print "$r"` printed SCALAR(0x...)); this is
the same rep-2 blind spot on the ASSIGNMENT side.

FIX SHAPE: rep 2 is a representation wart, not a semantic distinction -- either
(a) teach the ONE resolver used by the glob-assign family to walk a wrapper
    (a shared `%p-glob-designator` helper: rep 1, rep 2 and a raw typeglob all
    answer the same p-typeglob), or
(b) stop creating rep 2 for typeglobs in `p-scalar-=` (measure what else reads
    rep 2 first -- `\$x` and `\@a` use it too and rely on it).
(a) is the smaller blast radius.  Grep for the other `(p-typeglob-p inner)`
dispatchers first (p-glob-assign-dynamic, p-dynamic-typeglob, %p-resolve-fh,
p-prototype) -- they share the wart.
BAR: probes for both spellings ? {glob copy, CODE slot, filehandle use,
*{$g}{CODE}} vs perl + the full sweep.
title: *glob = $pkgvar where the package variable holds \*foo installs the SCALAR slot instead of copying the glob (p-scalar-='s box-in-box shape is invisible to %p-glob-assign-slots)
